author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Fresh trout, homemade dough, and simple village ingredients come together in this hearty baked fish pie 🌿🔥 In this video, we prepare a rustic trout pie from scratch, turning fresh fish into a warm and comforting homemade meal.

The trout filling is carefully prepared and wrapped in soft handmade dough, then baked until the crust becomes beautifully golden. Inside, the fish stays tender and juicy, creating a delicious combination of fresh flavors and traditional baking.

Baked trout pie is a wonderful way to enjoy fresh fish in a simple countryside style. Homemade dough, fresh trout, and rustic baking create a satisfying family meal with the authentic flavors of village cooking. 🐟🥧🌿
title: Baked Trout Pie | Homemade Village Style Recipe 🌿🔥
